documentation.subject: ${SERVICE_NAME}: the process keeps restarting
documentation.content:
The API process started more than six times in ten minutes. A deploy produces one or two; a crash loop produces this.

Counted from the API's own `application_started` log line rather than from container starts, so it means "the process booted" and not "the platform scheduled an instance".

Runbook: `docs/ops/deployment-runbooks.md`, "A revision will not stay up".

First three commands:

    gcloud logging read 'resource.labels.service_name="${SERVICE_NAME}" AND jsonPayload.event="application_started"' --freshness 30m --limit 20 --format='value(timestamp,jsonPayload.release,jsonPayload.deploymentId)'
    gcloud logging read 'resource.labels.service_name="${SERVICE_NAME}" AND severity>=ERROR' --freshness 30m --limit 50
    gcloud run revisions list --service ${SERVICE_NAME} --region europe-west3 --sort-by='~metadata.creationTimestamp' --limit 5 --format='table(metadata.name,metadata.labels.release)'

Stop condition: if every start reports the same release, the release is the cause — roll back. If the release changes between starts, two deploys are racing and the concurrency group is not doing its job; stop deploying before investigating further.

Not enabled for `dev`: dev scales to zero, so a start after every idle period is normal there and this would only ever be noise.

conditions.displayName: More than six process starts in ten minutes
